description: Helm archetype for repos with Helm subcharts. Groups helmv3 chart-dependency bumps.

postUpgradeTasks.description: Regenerate helm-docs chart READMEs after a bump so the helm-docs pre-commit check does not fail in CI. The runner's RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS must permit helm-docs; the entrypoint installs the binary. prefect-helm renders README.md from README.md.gotmpl.

packageRules.description: Group Helm chart-dependency (subchart) bumps into a single PR.
